profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a recent Master’s graduate in Computer Science with 3+ years of professional experience as a software engineer. I specialize in modern web technologies including Next.js, React, and Express, with a strong focus on mobile-first design.

Driven, detail-oriented, and collaborative, I take pride in writing clean, efficient code while fostering a positive and productive team environment. I value mentorship, continuous learning, and am deeply committed to helping both my peers and the organization succeed.

My long-term goal is to grow into a tech lead role, where I can combine technical expertise with leadership to build impactful products and strong, cohesive teams.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Drive end-to-end development, lead and manage the web team in designing, developing, and maintaining an AI-powered healthcare assistant web application.
- Oversee project planning, code quality, and team collaboration while mentoring interns through technical guidance, code reviews, and best practices to deliver a scalable, secure, and maintainable codebase.
- Build automated CI/CD workflows and utilize Docker to streamline the team’s development process and enhance deployment efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented secure user authentication feature using 0Auth protocol, including social logins (Google, Facebook, Instagram), boosting the sign-up rates by 150%.
- Took ownership of a cross-platform React Native mobile app, implementing a new feature that generates an ad revenue stream from over 100,000 users on the Apple App Store, and managed the app store submission process.
- Consistently recognized as a top contributor in code reviews and mentorship, improving code quality, team productivity, and the growth of peers.

positions.title: Mobile and Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a Content Management System web application from the ground up using ReactJS, ExpressJS, and Firebase, team workflow efficiency and reducing task completion time.
- Designed and implemented visually appealing, reusable web components with functional React components, leveraging TailwindCSS for efficiency and MaterializeUI for enhanced aesthetics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and built engaging and interactive web pages optimized to be mobile responsive and SEO-friendly.
Collaborated with the Marketing content team to manage and execute all content updates on multiple websites.
Improved website loading speed by using static site generators and re-design UI to meet modern standards while keeping it user-friendly.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Mobile Tech Lead
positions.description:
• Improved college students’ experience by developing mobile applications and web applications that solve real-world problems.
• Organized weekly Scrum meetings and supported more than 10 team members in technical skills.

company.name: State University of New York College at Plattsburgh

positions.title: Community Advocate/Resident Assistant
positions.description:
• Acted as a liaison between the students living on my floor and the campus community. 
• Helped build community by doing a wide range of programming, holding floor meetings and by assisting in keeping the Residence Halls safe and secure. 
• Worked with First-Year students to acclimate them to the college environment by encouraging student involvement.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Hold office hours and assist students during lab sessions for Introduction to Programming course at State University of New York at Plattsburgh.

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: • Conducted one-on-one or group tutoring sessions in an effort to provide students with additional support and clarification on key concepts and theories relative to Mathematics and Computer Science courses.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced authentication security and streamlined the login process by integrating OKTA Single Sign-On into an existing web application.
• Improved and debugged outdated custom React components by implementing React Hooks.
• Collaborated with other software engineers to achieve optimal application architecture and design.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a ticket management tool in Windows platform for Van Don International Airport's Parking system.
• Managed the internship team, who were participating in the project, at Innovative Technology Development Corporation using Trello, Redmine.

educations.schoolName: State University of New York at Plattsburgh

certifications.name: Responsible Conduct of Research for Engineers
certifications.title: Responsible Conduct of Research for Engineers

projects.title: DeliverIt
projects.description:
• Spearheaded a team of 6 people to build an online ordering app in a span of 3 months.
• Applied ReactJS and NodeJS to build dynamic web components.

projects.title: Shuttler
projects.description:
• Design and develop a shuttle tracking mobile app to support students with identifying bus stop times for Coding Hub at SUNY Plattsburgh.
• Incorporated with Firebase Realtime Database to delivery fluid experience.
